heard: What if you dug straight down and never stopped? In 1970, Soviet scientists tried it for real. Their hole was just 23 centimeters wide, about the size of a dinner plate. For 19 years, the drill went down 1 kilometer, 5, 10. At 12,262 meters, it became the deepest hole humans have ever made. But down there, something was wrong. The rock was 180 degrees Celsius, far hotter than anyone expected. You see, at that heat, rock stops acting like rock. It starts to behave like plastic. The drill simply could not go any deeper. So how far did they get? The center of the earth is 6,371 kilometers down. After 19 years of digging, they made it 0.2% of the way.
